name: 82nd Airborne Division War Memorial Museum
scope: Exterior of the public 82nd Airborne Division War Memorial Museum, the permanent 1957 museum and its attached additions at 5108 Ardennes Street.

review.notes: Checked both Qualla articles first. Their photographs show exhibits, a freestanding monument or other buildings. Confirmed public-domain supplemental views were also of exhibits or memorial ceremonies. Uncredited incidental images were excluded. The reconstruction uses the jointly mapped public museum outline and the director’s written building history.
